title: Filler auxiliary index
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a+3\le K$. For each $j\in\{0,1,2\}$, the filler auxiliary index is the coordinate in the $r+K$ coordinate set obtained by adding $r$ to $a+j$.
